in_hebrew.name: ביווס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Bevis in Hebrew means strength or power. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'bevet' which means strength or power.

in_greek.name: Βεβις
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Bevis in Greek is derived from the Greek word 'bios' meaning 'man' and the suffix '-is' meaning 'of'. Thus, Bevis in Greek can be translated to 'man of God'.

in_latin.name: Bevisius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Bevisius in Latin is derived from Bevis and the suffix '-ius' meaning 'living or belonging to'. Thus, Bevisius in Latin can be translated to 'living or belonging to Bevis'.
